description: You are a Facilities Planner at a commercial real estate firm that manages multiple office buildings. The company has just adopted OpenMaint and needs to establish its first preventive maintenance program. Using OpenMaint (login: admin/admin at http://localhost:8090/cmdbuild/ui/), create a quarterly HVAC preventive maintenance schedule covering all three office buildings in the system. Specifically: (1) Create three new preventive maintenance activity cards — one per building — each with Code following the pattern 'PM-HVAC-Q-{BuildingCode}', a Description that specifies quarterly HVAC filter replacement and coil inspection for that building, and a scheduled frequency/recurrence set to 90 days or quarterly; (2) Each activity must reference the correct building in its location/building field; (3) Each activity must include a detailed task checklist or notes field listing at minimum: filter replacement, coil cleaning, refrigerant level check, thermostat calibration, and condensate drain inspection; (4) Set the priority of all three activities to 'medium' or 'normal'. A PM requirements specification is saved at /home/ga/Desktop/pm_requirements.txt. Do not modify or delete any existing maintenance records.
